typography.notes: Target demographic is ~50-year-old adults. Typography must prioritize legibility. Avoid ultra-thin weights. Line-height should be generous (`leading-relaxed` for body).

colors.notes: Palette inspired by a considered, calm local concierge. Uses warm sand/off-white for background, deep forest green for primary action, and terracotta for accents/reactions. Do not use pure white or pure black.

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Flat Solid surfaces with soft ambient shadows (`shadow-sm`, `shadow-md`) and delicate 1px borders (`border-neutral-200`). NO heavy glassmorphism for this demographic. NO neon.
visual_enhancers.border_radius: Subtle roundness (`rounded-xl` or `rounded-2xl` for cards, `rounded-full` for chips/pills).
visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle grain or warm solid colors to make the app feel warm and organic, but keep it very clean so it doesn't distract.
visual_enhancers.spacing: Generous. Use `p-6` or `p-8` for sections to allow the design to breathe. Ensure touch targets are at least 48x48px.

layouts.core: Mobile-first Web App. Max-width container (`max-w-md` or `max-w-lg` centered on desktop to mimic mobile view) with `min-h-screen bg-background-default`.
layouts.navigation: Fixed bottom tab bar for mobile containing: Today, Upcoming, Our Ideas, History. Secondary nav (Preferences, Learned, Admin) can be in a top header profile/menu.
layouts.excursion_card: Progressive disclosure. Collapsed state: Image (aspect-video or square), Name, Category, Date, 'Why worthwhile now' snippet. Quick reaction buttons (Interested, Not today, Not for us). Expanded state: Accordion revealing 'Why unique', 'Fit', 'Cost', 'Travel', 'Verification status'.
layouts.ideas_queue: Dense list or bento grid with distinct status badges (queued, researching, etc).
layouts.tell_the_curator: Prominent natural-language text area with a 'Confirm interpretation' block directly below it.
layouts.learned_insights: Grid of preference cards with 'Accept/Edit/Dismiss' actions.

motion.transitions: Warm, calm, and practical. Use `transition-transform transition-opacity duration-300 ease-in-out` for hover states. DO NOT use `transition-all` globally.
motion.card_expansion: Smooth height interpolation for progressive disclosure on cards.
motion.page_load: Subtle fade and slight slide-up (`translate-y-2`) for list items to feel polished.

accessibility.contrast: Strict APCA/WCAG AA compliance. Text on backgrounds must have strong contrast. E.g., Use dark slate for body text over off-white backgrounds.
accessibility.touch_targets: Minimum 48x48px for all interactive elements (buttons, tabs, reaction icons).
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST have `data-testid` attributes (e.g., `data-testid="reaction-interested-btn"`).

component_name.bottom_tabs: Custom fixed bottom navigation using `lucide-react` icons.
component_name.cards: Custom built using `div` with HTML/Tailwind for the specific progressive disclosure needs. Avoid rigid Shadcn Cards if they restrict layout.
component_name.drawer: Shadcn `Drawer` (Bottom Sheet) for secondary actions like Filters (Easier, Quieter, Less driving, etc).
component_name.badges: Shadcn `Badge` for status (queued, eligible, etc) and 'DEMO data'.

instructions_to_main_agent: Design a mobile-first web app mimicking a native app experience. If viewed on desktop, center the main content in a max-width container with a subtle background to represent the phone canvas.
Implement a fixed bottom navigation bar (Home/Today, Upcoming, Ideas, History).
The UI must feel 'considered, warm, calm, practical, and specific'. Avoid flashy tech/AI aesthetics.
Build the Excursion Card as a highly robust component. It must have a collapsed state (quick scan & react) and an expanded state (deep details, fit score, verification links).
For 'Tell the curator', use a large, natural-language text area. When the user types, show a 'Proposed Interpretation' block below it to confirm understanding.
In Preferences, provide clear distinct toggle sections and utilize the 'What the curator has learned' feature as a summary panel.
Use Lucide-React for all iconography. Keep icons uniform in size (usually `w-6 h-6` for nav, `w-5 h-5` for buttons).
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You MUST use `.js` or `.jsx` extensions for React components. Do NOT use `.tsx` or TypeScript.
Ensure high contrast and readable font sizes. This app targets adults ~50 years old.
Do NOT use HTML `<select>` for dropdowns, use Shadcn Select or Drawer components.
Do NOT use generic 'transition: all' in CSS.
Always add `data-testid` attributes to interactive elements.
Do NOT use pure black or pure white backgrounds. Tint backgrounds slightly (e.g., #FDFBF7).
Provide empty, loading, and offline states for lists.
Clearly label mock data with DEMO badges.
